source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 507 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 507 was established by Ordinance No. 23545, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 10, 1998. Ordinance No. 23545 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 23545 was amended by Ordinance No. 24169, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 26, 2000. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23545; 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 507 is established on property generally located along the north line of East Wheatland Road, west of the west line Buford Drive. The size of PD 507 is approximately 20 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23545; 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article. In this article, SLASH means organic debris consisting of trees, branches, and other vegetation that has not been chipped, shredded, or otherwise processed on site.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Development And Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.104. DEVELOPMENT AND LANDSCAPE PLAN.

(a) For the nursery, garden shop, or plant sales use, the office use, the outside storage (without visual screening) use, and the outside storage (with visual screening) use, development and use of the Property must comply with the development/landscape plan (Exhibit 507A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development/landscape plan, the provisions of this article control.

(b) For all other permitted uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of and amendments to a site plan, a development plan, and a landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Nursery, garden shop, or plant sales.

(b) Office.

(c) Outside storage (without visual screening) limited to the storage of woodchips that have not been chipped on site.

(d) Outside storage (with visual screening) limited to the storage of operable vehicles and equipment only, the storage of slash and firewood. Equipment includes, but is not limited to, tree removal and planting equipment such as trailers, boring equipment, and log cutting/clipping equipment. Vehicles exceeding two-ton capacity are not allowed.

(e) All uses permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code. For example, a use permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District by specific use permit (SUP) only is permitted in this district by SUP only. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district, etc. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.106. ACCESSORY USES.

(a) As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations contained in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217.

(b) The following accessory uses are not permitted in this district:

-- Accessory helistop. -- Accessory medical/infectious waste incinerator. -- Accessory outside display of merchandise excluding a nursery, garden shop, or plant sales use. -- Accessory pathological waste incinerator. -- Day home. -- Pedestrian skybridges. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front yard.

(1) Minimum front yard for the nursery, garden shop, or plant sales use and the office use is as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(2) Minimum front yard for the outside storage (without visual screening) use and the outside storage (with visual screening) use is as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(3) For all other permitted uses, consult Section 51A-4.112(f) for the minimum front yard requirement.

(b) Side and rear yard.

(1) Minimum side and rear yard for the nursery, garden shop, or plant sales use and the office use is as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(2) Minimum side and rear yard for the outside storage (without visual screening) use and the outside storage (with visual screening) use is as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(3) For all other permitted uses, consult Section 51A-4.112(f) for the minimum side and rear yard requirements.

(c) Dwelling unit density. No maximum dwelling unit density.

(d) Floor area.

(1) Maximum permitted floor area for the nursery, garden shop, or plant sales use is 1,500 square feet.

(2) Maximum permitted floor area for the office use is 500 square feet which must be located in the existing single family house shown on the development/landscape plan.

(e) Height.

(1) Maximum structure height for the nursery, garden shop, or plant sales use and the office use is 30 feet.

(2) Maximum permitted height for the storage of slash and firewood is nine feet.

(3) Maximum permitted height for the storage of woodchips is two feet.

(4) For all other permitted uses, maximum structure height regulations for the R- 7.5(A) Single Family District in Sections 51A-4.112 and 51A-4.408 apply in this district.

(f) Lot coverage.

(1) Maximum lot coverage for the nursery, garden shop, or plant sales use is 0.2 percent.

(2) Maximum lot coverage for the outside storage (without visual screening) is 4.8 percent.

(3) Maximum lot coverage for the outside storage (with visual screening) is 3.1 percent.

(4) For all other permitted uses, maximum lot coverage regulations for the R-7.5(A) Single Family District contained in Sections 51A-4.112 and 51A-4.407 apply in this district.

(g) Lot size. Minimum lot area for residential uses is 7,500 square feet.

(h) Stories. No maximum number of stories. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) For the nursery, garden shop, or plant sales use, the office use, the outside storage (without visual screening) use, and the outside storage (with visual screening) use, 41 off-street parking spaces must be located as shown on the development/landscape plan.

(b) For all other permitted uses, consult the use regulations (Division 51A-4.200) for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Divisions 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Hours Of Operation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.109. HOURS OF OPERATION.

(a) For the nursery, garden shop, or plant sales use, hours of operation are limited to 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday through Saturday.

(b) Access to and from the outside storage (without visual screening) area and the outside storage (with visual screening) area is limited to the hours of 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m., Monday through Saturday. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.110. SCREENING.

(a) Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for a nursery, garden shop, or plant sales use, solid screening must be provided as shown in the area designated as nursery, garden shop, or plant sales on the development/landscape plan.

(b) Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for an outside storage (with visual screening) use, solid screening a minimum of nine feet in height must be provided as shown in the area designated as outside storage area with visual screening on the development/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

(a) The grinding of wood or any other material is prohibited.

(b) The use of a saw mill is prohibited.

(c) For additional standards, see Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for a nursery, garden shop, or plant sales use, an office use, an outside storage (without visual screening) use, or an outside storage (with visual screening) use, landscaping must be installed as shown on the development/landscape plan. The building official must approve all plant materials to be used by the property owner in accordance with the requirements of Article X. All landscaping must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition.

(b) For all other permitted uses, landscaping must be provided in accordance with the requirements of Article X. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.113. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.115. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-507.117. ZONING MAP.

PD 507 is located on Zoning Map No. P-7. (Ord. Nos. 24169; 26042)
